title: Lead GPU Cluster Solution Architect
desc:
ABOUT THE ROLE
Axe Compute is seeking a Lead Architect, GPU Cluster Solutions to design GPU cluster configurations for prospective and signed engagements, translating client requirements and NVIDIA Reference Architecture into a buildable, supportable design, spanning compute, storage, networking, software and spares strategy for support.


ROLE AT A GLANCE
Mandate: Own end-to-end technical design of GPU cluster deployments, from client requirements through NVIDIA Reference Architecture compliance and sparing strategy.
Scope: Cluster design, network architecture (InfiniBand/RoCE/Ethernet), sparing and spares planning, connectivity design (internet/VPN/firewall, dedicated circuits), design adjustments for site and hardware constraints.
Key Outcomes: Designs that meet client SLAs and NVIDIA Reference Architecture standards, sparing plans that protect uptime commitments, designs that account for real-world site and hardware lead-time constraints.


WHAT YOU WILL OWN
Cluster Design & Reference Architecture
Design GPU cluster configurations (compute, storage, networking) against NVIDIA Reference Architecture for each signed engagement.
Translate client technical requirements into a complete bill of design, including all necessary compute, storage, and networking components.
Network Architecture
Design network topology and fabric selection, including InfiniBand, RoCE, and Ethernet options, appropriate to each client's workload and performance requirements.
Incorporate internet, VPN, and firewall connectivity requirements into cluster designs.
Design dedicated point-to-point network requirements where needed, including protected optical circuits and similar dedicated connectivity.
Sparing & Availability Strategy
Formulate and own the hot/cold sparing plan for each deployment to meet contracted SLA commitments.
Adjust sparing and design assumptions based on data center power/cooling parameters and hardware lead-time constraints.
Design Adaptation & Site Constraints
Adjust cluster designs to fit site-specific power, cooling, and space constraints identified by the Data Center Procurement and Operations Director.
Work with Supply Chain to align design decisions with realistic hardware delivery timing.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with the VP, Deployments and Deployment Program Manager to ensure designs translate cleanly into buildable, trackable project plans.
Support acceptance test design and criteria definition, ensuring test procedures validate the as-designed architecture.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
7+ years in solutions architecture, network engineering, or systems engineering supporting GPU, HPC, or large-scale compute infrastructure.
Deep working knowledge of NVIDIA Reference Architecture (HGX, NVL72) and GPU cluster design principles.
Hands-on experience with InfiniBand, RoCE, and high-speed Ethernet fabric design.
Experience designing sparing/spares strategies for mission-critical infrastructure.
Experience incorporating firewall, VPN, and dedicated circuit (e.g., protected optical) requirements into network designs.
Experience with high-speed shared storage solutions (e.g., Weka, Vast, DDN).


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Experience designing clusters for large enterprise clients or neoclouds, not just internal infrastructure.
Familiarity with NVIDIA NCP program requirements and certification processes.
Experience with capacity or sparing modeling tools.

title: Senior Systems Engineer II - Mission Architecture
desc:
About Rocket Lab

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR SYSTEMS ENGINEER II – MISSION ARCHITECTURE

Based out of Rocket Lab's global headquarters in Long Beach, CA the Senior Systems Engineer is responsible for leading the formulation of all new satellite systems, supporting capture of new civil, national security, and commercial business. You will manage the development and maintenance of technical budgets, requirements definition, test planning and execution, and overall management of the systems engineering process, including validation of customer requirements. desc:

Who will you be working with?

Wabtec's Train Handling solutions include Trip Optimizer® and Locotrol®, which work together to optimize train performance and automate freight operations. Trip Optimizer creates and executes fuel-efficient operating plans that meet schedule and train-handling requirements, while Locotrol enables coordinated control of distributed locomotives throughout the train. Together, these technologies improve train handling, fuel efficiency, operational safety, and the ability to operate longer and heavier trains.

As a Systems Engineer, you will collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, product management, program leadership, and railroad customers to develop and deliver advanced train automation solutions that drive operational efficiency and business value.

How will you make a difference?

As a Systems Engineer, you will lead portions of the design, development, integration, and deployment of Wabtec's Train Handling portfolio. You will define and manage system requirements, perform trade studies, coordinate verification and validation activities, and contribute to product strategy and feature development.

The successful candidate will bring an AI-native mindset, proactively leveraging AI technologies throughout the engineering lifecycle to accelerate innovation, improve product quality, and enhance customer outcomes. You will identify opportunities to apply advanced analytics, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities to solve complex operational challenges and improve system performance.

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Mathematics or Computer Science from an accredited college or university 
Minimum of 5 years hands-on design, requirements development and implementation experience involving; Engineering Systems, Hardware / Software Engineering, and/or Data Information Systems 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
Strong oral and written communication skills 
Ability to work in a cross-functional, global environment 
Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally 


What will your typical day look like?

Lead the design, development, integration, testing, and enhancement of Train Handling solutions while applying sound systems engineering principles and established product development processes.

Partner with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Software Engineering, Train Control, Office Systems, Safety, Validation, and Applications Engineering, to deliver high-quality solutions on schedule. 
Drive requirements reviews, design reviews, technical assessments, and verification and validation activities throughout the product lifecycle. 
Investigate and resolve complex technical issues by analyzing system performance, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective actions. 
Plan and execute field testing, validation, and operational evaluations to ensure solutions meet customer expectations and performance requirements. 
Develop and maintain technical documentation, engineering deliverables, project status updates, and system specifications. 
Collaborate directly with railroad customers, subject matter experts, and internal stakeholders to understand operational challenges and translate them into effective technical solutions. 
Apply industry standards, engineering best practices, and emerging technologies to continuously improve product capabilities, reliability, and performance. 
Leverage AI-enabled tools and technologies to accelerate analysis, improve engineering productivity, support decision-making, and enhance product innovation. 


Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated experience applying systems engineering principles throughout the product development lifecycle. 
Experience working with software, controls, automation, transportation, embedded, or safety-critical systems. 
Familiarity with systems architecture, requirements management, verification and validation, and systems integration activities. 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to influence technical decisions. 
Experience collaborating across multiple engineering disciplines and managing competing priorities in a dynamic environment. 
Demonstrated ability to apply AI-enabled tools, advanced analytics, or data-driven approaches to improve engineering outcomes. 
Working knowledge of railroad operations, train control systems, AAR standards, CENELEC standards, or other transportation industry regulations is preferred.

Wabtec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable) and fitness for duty test (as applicable).

Other benefit offerings for this role may include annual bonus, if eligible.

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. Link Snacks is seeking a Cybersecurity Platform Engineer to join our Global IT organization. The Cybersecurity Platform Engineer serves as the technical owner for key security tools and capabilities, ensuring they are properly designed, integrated, governed, monitored, and optimized to reduce risk and support business objectives.


This position requires deep hands-on engineering experience, strong cybersecurity fundamentals, and the ability to translate risk, compliance, and operational needs into scalable platform solutions. The Cybersecurity Platform Engineer will partner closely with infrastructure, networking, application, data, OT, and business teams to mature security controls across cloud, endpoint, identity, collaboration, and data protection environments. This role also requires strong automation, documentation, and communication skills to ensure security platforms are operationally sustainable, measurable, and aligned with global business needs.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Lead the engineering, administration, and continuous improvement of Microsoft Defender capabilities, including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Identity, Defender XDR, and related security integrations. 
Design, implement, and mature Microsoft Purview capabilities for data protection, information governance, data loss prevention, insider risk, eDiscovery support, retention, sensitivity labeling, and compliance-driven control enforcement. 
Engineer cloud security controls across Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environments, including secure configuration baselines, cloud security posture management, workload protection, logging, alerting, policy enforcement, and remediation tracking. 
Lead identity and access management engineering activities, including Entra ID, Active Directory, Conditional Access, privileged access, access reviews, identity lifecycle automation, service accounts, guest access, and secure authentication patterns. 
Develop automation, scripts, integrations, and repeatable processes that improve security platform reliability, reduce manual effort, standardize controls, and support consistent enforcement across global environments. 
Partner with security operations, MDR, SIEM, infrastructure, network, application, data, and OT teams to integrate cybersecurity platforms with detection, response, vulnerability management, incident response, and operational workflows. 
Create and maintain security platform standards, configuration baselines, procedures, runbooks, diagrams, operational documentation, and audit-ready evidence supporting regulatory and cybersecurity framework requirements. 
Define and report platform health, control effectiveness, adoption, remediation progress, secure configuration status, and other actionable security metrics for technical teams and leadership stakeholders. 
Evaluate emerging cybersecurity platform capabilities, Microsoft security roadmap changes, cloud security trends, and industry best practices to recommend practical improvements that strengthen the organization’s security posture. 
Perform other duties as assigned. 


Qualifications

Required Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
4 + years of hands-on experience engineering, administering, or improving cybersecurity platforms across Microsoft security, cloud security, identity, endpoint, data protection, or security operations domains. 
Strong foundation in cybersecurity platform engineering, including endpoint security, cloud security, IAM data protection, compliance controls, automation, and incident response support. 
Proficient in Microsoft security and identity technologies, Windows, Linux, PowerShell, scripting, API-based integrations, and automation of security operations processes. 
Strong experience with Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, Active Directory, Microsoft Sentinel, and Microsoft 365 security and compliance capabilities. 
Skilled in platform configuration, log analysis, alert tuning, dashboarding, control validation, secure baseline development, and remediation tracking. 
Proven ability to secure both IT and OT networks, including experience with incident response, alert triaging, and vulnerability management. 
Proficient in managing identity and access controls, including Active Directory administration and privileged access management. 
Skilled in executing cybersecurity strategies and enforcing technical policies across enterprise environments. 
Experienced in working with security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and GDPR. 
Capable of managing vendor relationships and coordinating with internal/external stakeholders on security incidents and compliance matters. 
Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, risk management, encryption, authentication, and access control. 
In-depth knowledge of network and infrastructure security, including virtualization, wireless technologies, and email systems. 
Familiarity with security technologies and tools, including SIEM platforms, automated penetration testing tools, and cloud risk assessment methodologies. 
Knowledgeable in security design, technical governance, and third-party auditing practices. 
Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
Demonstrated discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information. 
Strong adaptability, time management, and independent problem-solving skills. 
Ability to remain composed under pressure and provide after-hours support when necessary. 
Willingness to travel up to 10% for training and business-related activities. 
Preferred Qualifications


Experience serving as the primary engineer or platform owner for capabilities such as Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud, Tenable Nessus, BeyondTrust, Palo Alto, or similar enterprise security technologies. 
Experience developing scalable security platform roadmaps, improving control maturity, reducing manual operational effort, and translating security requirements into technical implementation plans. 
Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, Microsoft Security, or equivalent practical experience. 
Experience securing OT/industrial networks in manufacturing or consumer packaged goods environments. 
Familiarity with Power BI, Fabric, or similar tools for security data analysis and reporting. 
 




Additional Information

The starting salarie for this role is $115,000.00 - $130,000.00. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, and candidate skill set and experience. Base pay is just one component of Link’ Snacks Total Rewards package for Team Members. Other rewards may include annual incentive and program-specific awards. Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS 


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to be successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this job the Team Member is regularly required to sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear. The Team Member is occasionally required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The Team Member must occasionally lift and/or more up to twenty-five pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

title: Cyber Security Engineer (Cloud Security)
desc:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Security Engineer (Cloud Security) based in the United States.

As a Cyber Security Engineer specializing in Cloud Security, you will play a critical role in protecting cloud infrastructure, containerized workloads, and infrastructure-as-code environments within a healthcare technology setting. You will lead initiatives to strengthen cloud security posture, implement Zero Trust access strategies, and safeguard sensitive data across complex environments. Working primarily with Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, and modern security platforms, you will identify vulnerabilities, mitigate risks, and continuously improve security controls. You will also contribute to incident response, identity and access management, and broader enterprise security operations. Collaborating closely with IT, SRE, and development teams, you will embed security practices throughout infrastructure and software delivery processes. This remote opportunity is ideal for a hands-on security professional who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex challenges, and working in a collaborative, regulated environment.

Accountabilities

Responsibilities

In this role, you will strengthen cloud security operations, protect critical infrastructure, and ensure compliance with relevant security and regulatory standards. Your main responsibilities will include:

Manage and secure cloud infrastructure and cloud-based applications, primarily within Microsoft Azure environments. 
Protect containerized workloads and Kubernetes environments, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), through network policies, workload identity controls, runtime protection, and container image scanning. 
Own and continuously improve Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), identifying and remediating configuration weaknesses across cloud environments. 
Secure infrastructure-as-code orchestration platforms, including Terraform and OpenTofu, by implementing access controls, secrets management, and deployment approval workflows. 
Manage identity and access security through Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, Entitlement Management, and just-in-time (JIT) privileged access models. 
Review network architectures and proposed connectivity changes, providing security recommendations on network segmentation, sensitive data flows, and firewall controls. 
Collaborate with IT and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to investigate and resolve network security concerns. 
Administer Zero Trust network access and edge security solutions to protect access to corporate and cloud resources. 
Manage broader enterprise security solutions, including SIEM, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Extended Detection and Response (XDR), and vulnerability management tools. 
Monitor security alerts, investigate potential threats, respond to incidents, and participate in the security incident response on-call rotation. 
Conduct threat analyses, vulnerability assessments, and risk evaluations, documenting findings, coordinating remediation efforts, and reporting progress to leadership. 
Develop queries, scripts, integrations, and automated workflows to improve cloud security operations and operational efficiency. 
Partner with development teams to integrate security practices into the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and CI/CD pipelines. 
Perform regular cloud configuration and access reviews to maintain compliance with established security standards. 
Participate in security audits and assessments, supporting governance, risk management, and compliance (GRC) initiatives. 


Requirements

The ideal candidate is a hands-on cloud security professional with extensive experience protecting modern cloud environments, containerized applications, and enterprise infrastructure. You should bring the following qualifications and technical capabilities:

Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will also be considered. 
At least 5 years of experience in cloud security engineering or a closely related role. 
Extensive hands-on experience securing cloud infrastructure and cloud-based applications, preferably in Microsoft Azure; AWS experience is an advantage. 
Strong network security expertise, including network architecture, connectivity, segmentation, and firewall management. 
Practical experience securing containerized workloads and Kubernetes environments, particularly AKS, including network policies, workload identities, and runtime protection. 
Experience with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) tools and remediation of cloud misconfigurations. 
Experience securing infrastructure-as-code platforms and deployment pipelines, particularly Terraform or OpenTofu. 
Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, Entitlement Management, and just-in-time privileged access. 
Experience implementing Zero Trust and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) solutions, such as Cloudflare Zero Trust, WAF, and Gateway, or equivalent technologies. 
Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS, as well as compliance frameworks including HITRUST and PCI DSS. 
Proven ability to perform security assessments, manage vulnerabilities, investigate threats, and support incident response activities. 
Strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems and endpoint security practices. 
Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, SSCP, Security+, or Azure/AWS cloud security certifications are preferred. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to take ownership of security initiatives and drive them through completion. 
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. 
Adaptability, curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging security technologies and threats. 


Additional Qualifications Considered An Advantage Include

Familiarity with GitOps tools such as Argo and Flux for secure Kubernetes deployments. 
Previous experience in Network Engineering or Systems Engineering. 
Knowledge of programming and scripting languages. 
Experience working in healthcare technology or other regulated environments. 


Benefits

Competitive annual salary ranging from $110,000 to $130,000. 
Employer-sponsored medical, dental, and vision insurance. 
Life and disability insurance coverage. 
Retirement savings plan with employer contributions. 
Annual company profit-sharing program. 
Dedicated budget for professional development and technical training. 
Open and collaborative working environment. 
Structured two-week onboarding program to support a smooth transition into the role. 
Comprehensive mentorship program to encourage professional growth and development. 
Fully remote working arrangement.

title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer
desc:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here. 

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

We are bringing a new model to space access: one in which every link in an enormous value chain isn’t limited by those around it. We design rocket engines and propulsion solutions.

Our products and technologies require an extraordinary team—one that will ensure the security of tomorrow’s technologies while deploying today’s best. We are an intrinsically motivated team with a passion for solving problems and empowering each other every day.

About The Role

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Level 3 w/ Clearance) within our Digital Operations team, you won’t just be monitoring alerts or checking compliance boxes. You will be a hands-on technical problem solver and trusted advisor who bridges the gap between commercial enterprise operations and cleared defense program execution—helping our hardware, software, and manufacturing engineers navigate complex security environments without slowing down the pace of innovation.

Reporting up through Digital Operations, you will sit at the intersection of DevOps, Digital Manufacturing, Software Engineering, Zero-Trust Networking, and IT. As Ursa Major scales from 380 to 500+ employees and doubles our cleared cybersecurity bench, you will play a central role in both evolving our CMMC Level 2 posture and maintaining hands-on security engineering across classified spaces, secure labs, and air-gapped networks

Responsibilities

Stakeholder Enablement & Creative Risk Mitigation
Partner directly with non-cyber employees (program managers, propulsion engineers, test stand operators, cleared defense leads) to understand their workflows and help them safely manage CUI and classified data flows without unnecessary friction.
Approach security challenges with nuance rather than black-and-white rules. Find pragmatically secure pathways that satisfy federal requirements (RMF, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171) while keeping physical hardware engineering, CAD/CAM development, and classified testing moving forward.
Design controls around engineering workflows to eliminate latency and operational bottlenecks, ensuring compliance feels like an accelerator rather than a roadblock.
Classified Systems & Hybrid Security Engineering
Lead hands-on security engineering, vulnerability management, and continuous monitoring across classified program enclaves, air-gapped networks, and secure testing environments.
Execute Risk Management Framework (RMF) and JSIG lifecycle tasks—including system hardening using STIGs/SCAP, vulnerability scanning (ACAS/Tenable), eMASS package management, System Security Plan (SSP) authoring, and POA&M remediation.
Manage and optimize technical security controls (EDR, SIEM log aggregation, firewalls, identity platforms) across both enterprise and classified network environments.
Leadership & Technical Ownership (Level 3)
Act as a subject matter expert who tackles ambiguous, high-complexity security segmentation challenges with minimal supervision, taking full ownership from diagnosis to resolution.
Partner with physical security, FSO, and ISSM staff to support secure facility operations, media sanitization, DCSA audit readiness, and classified authorization packages.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior staff and IT team members, translating complex federal regulations into clear, actionable advice for non-cyber stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

Active DoD Secret clearance required (Top Secret or TS/SCI eligibility highly preferred).
4+ years of dedicated cybersecurity engineering experience in DoD, cleared defense contractor, or high-rigor regulated environments.
Current DoD 8570/8140 IAM/IAT Level II or III certification (e.g., Security+, CISSP, CISM, CASP+, or CySA+).
Deep familiarity with government regulations, specifically NIST SP 800-171, CMMC Level 2, NIST SP 800-53, RMF, and JSIG requirements.
Demonstrated experience executing STIG hardening, SCAP compliance scanning, vulnerability remediation, and EDR/SIEM administration across air-gapped or classified Windows/Linux environments.
Proven track record of working constructively with engineering and business stakeholders—focusing on trust-building, communication, and enabling business outcomes rather than simple ticket-taking.


Colorado law requires us to tell you the base compensation range of this role, which is $128,000 - $160,000, determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. What we can’t quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy.

title: System Administrator II
desc:
System Administrator II
Cheyenne, Wyoming 
Full-time, permanent (direct hire)
Schedule: Business hours, plus on-call rotation and occasional after-hours Maintenance: Candidates living in northern Colorado and commuting to Cheyenne are welcome; current team members do this today.
Position summary
We are hiring a System Administrator II to administer, maintain and support enterprise infrastructure across a multi-site organization. The organization is moving from VMware to Nutanix, so hands-on Nutanix experience paired with strong networking skills is essential.
This person will diagnose infrastructure issues independently across servers, storage, virtualization, networking and security. They will coordinate with vendors and service providers and support business-critical systems that run 24/7. Rubrik backup and recovery experience is highly desirable.
Essential duties and responsibilities
Nutanix and virtualization
Administer, monitor, maintain and troubleshoot Nutanix infrastructure, including clusters, hosts, virtual machines, storage and virtual networking.
Perform health monitoring, maintenance, upgrades and capacity management.
Troubleshoot performance, availability, storage and connectivity issues in virtualized environments.
Support infrastructure lifecycle planning and hardware refresh initiatives.
Support the ongoing transition away from VMware.
Networking
Configure, maintain, monitor and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Layer 2/3 switching, routing, VPN, wireless, WAN and network segmentation.
Troubleshoot connectivity end to end, from the endpoint through switching, routing, firewall, WAN and servers.
Support multi-site networks and coordinate troubleshooting with telecom carriers and ISPs.
Firewall and security
Configure, administer and troubleshoot enterprise firewalls, including policies, network objects, NAT rules, VPN connectivity and segmentation.
Assist with security remediation and infrastructure hardening.
Work with cybersecurity staff to investigate network and system security issues.
Backup, recovery and business continuity
Administer and monitor enterprise backup and recovery systems (Rubrik preferred).
Investigate and remediate backup job failures.
Perform and validate system, VM and data restores.
Participate in disaster recovery planning, documentation and testing to meet recovery objectives.
Microsoft infrastructure
Administer Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID.
Manage users, groups, computers, service accounts and permissions.
Support hybrid identity and Microsoft cloud services.
Systems administration and operational support
Monitor server health, capacity, availability and performance; perform patching and OS upgrades.
Diagnose complex hardware, OS, virtualization, storage and network problems.
Open and manage vendor support cases and escalations.
Maintain configurations, network diagrams, inventories and technical documentation.
Serve as a Tier II/III escalation point and lead troubleshooting during critical outages.
Participate in after-hours maintenance and an on-call rotation.
Communicate issues and outages clearly to IT leadership and business stakeholders.
Qualifications
Required

title: Senior Identity Security Engineer (Arlington, VA or San Diego, CA)
desc:
Overview

Job Description

CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP) is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index and the NASDAQ 100, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives.

We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.

In this role, you'll harden controls to empower 8000 employees to seamlessly and securely connect to company resources through a zero trust, FIDO2 compliant framework. You will assess, identify and mitigate risks across a large technical infrastructure and corporate environment. This position will work with Security, Systems, DevOps, Network, and Development teams to drive and shape the way our employees and engineers access our systems. This is an identity security engineering role rather than an IAM administration role: the candidate must have hands-on experience finding and eliminating identity attack paths, detecting identity-based attacks, and continuously validating the security of modern IAM platforms. Ideal candidates will have a thorough understanding of adversary in the middle attacks, token theft, social engineering attacks, and offensive privilege escalation techniques across Active Directory and Entra ID and have experience implementing or operating controls to prevent and detect such attacks.

This position can be in either Arlington, VA or San Diego, CA and is in office Monday through Thursday and work from home on Friday.

Responsibilities

Design, implement, and continuously improve identity security controls across various platforms
Harden Tier 0 identity infrastructure, including domain controllers, AD CS, Entra Connect, and privileged roles, in line with Microsoft’s Enterprise Access Model
Develop and maintain conditional access policies that enforce appropriate authentication strength, device compliance, etc including for privileged roles, sensitive applications, and workload identities
Analyze logs to scope and guide rollouts of new security initiatives
Support an org-wide, multi-platform phish-resistant authentication rollout
Engineer controls around AI and workload identities (service principals, managed identities, OAuth app registrations)
Research, prototype, and operationalize AI-assisted tooling and agentic workflows to improve team efficiency, including automating repetitive analysis and building internal tools that surface identity risk
Document projects, standards, and runbooks
Communicate frequently and effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Drive attack path management across Active Directory and Entra ID using commercial and open-source tools such as BloodHound (Enterprise or Community Edition) and AzureHound, prioritizing and remediating the paths that lead to Tier 0
Engineer, tune, and validate identity threat detections across Microsoft Defender for Identity, Entra ID Protection, and Okta, and partner with the SOC on identity-based incident response
Continuously validate identity configuration and catch drift with automated security testing, such as Maester for Entra ID and Microsoft 365
Stay current with the greater identity threat landscape as well as the identity defense offerings from major IDP vendors


Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree required from an accredited, not for profit, in person, university or college. 
A track record of commitment to prior employers 
Thorough understanding of AitM attacks (e.g., Evilginx) and token theft, and how to neutralize them through phish-resistant authentication, token protection, and strong identity security hygiene
4+ years of hands-on security engineering experience, including implementation of new controls to address threats
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision-making
Hands-on experience securing and hardening industry-standard IDPs (Okta, PingID, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory)
Knowledge of authentication and authorization protocols such as SAML, OAuth, OIDC, Kerberos
Working knowledge of how attackers abuse identity systems, such as Kerberoasting, DCSync, AD CS (ESC) abuse, illicit OAuth consent grants, and privilege escalation through Entra roles and app permissions, and the controls that prevent and detect each
Firm understanding of PKI, the FIDO2 framework, passkeys, Windows Hello for Business, and Platform SSO, Okta FastPass, Okta Device Trust
Solid understanding of role-based access control, least privilege, just-in-time access, and other identity security paradigms
Experience analyzing identity telemetry (Entra sign-in and audit logs, domain controller events, MDI alerts) in a SIEM, writing hunting and detection queries (e.g., KQL), and creating related dashboards
Ability to read and author basic scripts in at least one common language (Python, PowerShell, Bash)


Preferred Qualifications And Skills

Hands-on experience with one or more of the following, with examples of identity risks you found and remediated by using them: Microsoft Defender for Identity (MDI), SpecterOps BloodHound and AzureHound, or Maester
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Jamf, JumpCloud, or other MDM platforms
Experience with offensive identity tooling such as SharpHound, Responder, Rubeus, Certipy, or ROADtools, used to validate defensive controls
Record of automating operational tasks
Familiarity with CI/CD infrastructure
Experience configuring risk-based conditional access or authentication policies
Experience with workload identity governance
Strong written and verbal communications skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate complex topics with both engineering peers and non-technical audiences
Experience with AI/ML-assisted security tooling, including building or deploying LLM-based agents


What’s In It For You

When you join CoStar Group, you’ll experience a collaborative and innovative culture working alongside the best and brightest to empower our people and customers to succeed.

We offer you generous compensation and performance-based incentives. CoStar Group also invests in your professional and academic growth with internal training, and tuition reimbursement.

title: Senior Active Directory Engineer
desc:

Fulltime

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Senior Active Directory Engineer to join the Infrastructure Engineering and Design team. This role requires strong expertise in identity and access services, Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), Microsoft Entra ID, federation, directory synchronization, Group Policy, authentication, and related Windows Server technologies. The engineer will translate business, security, and technical requirements into reliable, supportable, and deployable solutions across on-premises and cloud-connected identity environments.
The successful candidate will partner with Infrastructure, Security, Server Engineering, subsidiary technology teams, and other stakeholders. The role may provide technical leadership for focused project efforts and must effectively manage multiple concurrent priorities in a highly matrixed organization.


Primary Responsibilities 
Directory Services Engineering and Operations 
Provide enterprise operational and engineering support for Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments.
Design, implement, maintain, and document Active Directory forests, domains, organizational units, sites, subnets, domain controllers, and replication topology.
Monitor and assess the health, availability, capacity, performance, and configuration of directory servers and supporting services.
Troubleshoot complex replication, domain controller location, name resolution, federation, authentication, authorization, and directory synchronization issues.
Monitor and troubleshoot Kerberos authentication, including service principal name, delegation, ticketing, and time-synchronization dependencies.
Manage non-production and test environments used to validate directory service changes, integrations, and recovery procedures.
Create and maintain engineering standards, templates, processes, procedures, support documentation, and operational runbooks for Active Directory services.
Provide technical leadership, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to engineers and operational support teams.

Administer Group Policy lifecycle controls in Advanced Group Policy Management (AGPM), including policy check-in, approval, deployment, and production locking.

Collaborate extensively with Security Engineering teams to identify and remediate privilege-escalation paths, chainable vulnerabilities, and other directory security risks.
Apply least-privilege, separation-of-duties, privileged-access, and Tier 0 security principles to the administration of directory services.
Support access reviews, audit evidence, compliance controls, and security remediation activities associated with identity infrastructure.


Resiliency, Recovery, and Continuous Improvement

Administer Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) and Web Application Proxy (WAP) infrastructure.

Partner with application and security teams to implement and maintain relying party trusts, claims, and related federation integrations.
Work with subsidiary Active Directory teams to consolidate, standardize, and integrate directory environments.

Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Experience managing enterprise identity and access management operations.
Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID tenant environments and traditional on-premises Active Directory configurations.
Hands-on experience supporting Active Directory Domain Services, Microsoft Entra Connect, AD FS, WAP, Kerberos, Group Policy, and enterprise authentication services.
Experience troubleshooting complex directory, synchronization, federation, replication, and authentication problems with minimal guidance.
Knowledge of scripting and data analysis using PowerShell, SQL, Microsoft Access, Microsoft Excel, and data-mapping techniques.
Experience designing and executing Active Directory backup and recovery processes.
Experience capturing server memory dumps for advanced troubleshooting.
Excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to translate technical findings into clear actions.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.
Ability to prioritize work independently and provide clear, documented status updates and metrics to management.
Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new concepts, capabilities, tools, and changing business requirements.
Ability to pass a federal clearance or background check to support dedicated United States Government environments.
Preferred Qualifications 
Experience with HIPAA compliance, FedRAMP access controls, and e-QIP certification processes.
Experience with Semperis Active Directory Forest Recovery (ADFR) and Directory Services Protector (DSP).


Education and Experience 
Typically requires a university degree or equivalent experience and a minimum of seven years of relevant experience, or an advanced degree and a minimum of five years of relevant experience.

desc:

Description

About the Role


The Systems Engineer, Architecture owns the long-term design of Shield's internal technology environment. You will own the architecture of our core platforms, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Azure, and our SaaS ecosystem, and ensure that every new tool, integration, and acquired environment fits a coherent, secure, and scalable design.

Architecture Ownership: Define and maintain the target-state architecture for Shield's internal systems, including identity, endpoint, collaboration, and cloud platforms. Maintain the technology roadmap and sequence changes to get from current state to target state.

Identity and Access Design: Own the identity architecture across Entra ID and connected SaaS, including SSO, SCIM provisioning, conditional access, and privileged access models. Design for scale as new entities and users are added.
Integration Architecture: Design how internal business systems connect, including HRIS-driven provisioning, PSA and ticketing platforms, and automation flows. Set the patterns that engineers implement.

title: Solutions Architect, Microsoft 365, Azure, Identity and Zero Trust
Principal IAM Engineer
desc:
About Lantern

Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. By curating a Network of Excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, Lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. Lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including Care Advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com.

Lantern is the specialty care platform, connecting people with high-quality, affordable specialty care close to home. We operate in a regulated healthcare environment (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2), we handle protected health information at scale, and we are becoming an AI healthcare company, with AI adoption a top company priority.

This Principal IAM Engineer is a senior level, individual-contributor role and the technical authority for identity at Lantern. In an organization where the security perimeter is effectively identity, you will own the identity control plane end to end, and you will determine who can reach PHI and under what conditions. You will set the identity standard, build the automation behind it, and hold the verification bar that other teams operate against.

You will report to the CISO and partner closely with our IAM engineer and with the platform, cloud, and service delivery teams that execute alongside you. This is a hands-on principal seat, not a people-management role today, with a clear path to expand into a leadership role as the identity function grows.

Our security philosophy is open by default, secure by design. Security exists to help the business move fast, safely, and the default answer is “yes, safely,” because guardrails are built into the platform, pipelines, and tooling rather than enforced by someone saying no. Gates exist only where risk genuinely warrants them, and even then they are automated, fast, and transparent.

Location: Hybrid - 3 days/wk in our NYC office preferred, but willing to consider Remote.

Responsibilities:

Own the identity lifecycle: joiner, mover, and leaver provisioning and deprovisioning, automated from role- and attribute-based models (RBAC/ABAC), with deprovisioning verified against an entitlement inventory rather than assumed.
Own access management, including Conditional Access, phishing-resistant MFA, and privileged access on a Zero Trust model, with least-privilege by default, just-in-time (JIT) elevation, and enforcement confirmed on every access path rather than only saved.
Own directory and federation across Entra ID, single sign-on, SAML, OIDC, and OAuth2.
Own secrets and non-human identity, including API keys, service accounts, and workload identity, and maintain an owner registry for them.
Own key access governance and separation of duties in a model where another team operates the key management system.
Own identity automation and identity-as-code, building lifecycle and access controls as reviewable, version-controlled infrastructure (Terraform and policy-as-code) rather than manual configuration.
Own the identity-verification standard the service desk follows for password resets, MFA resets, and device enrollment. This is a hands-on control point, because helpdesk-initiated resets are a leading account-takeover vector.


Key Deliverables in Your First Year:

Conditional Access enforced by default on PHI-facing applications, with enforcement verified.
Automated joiner, mover, and leaver provisioning and deprovisioning that meets its SLA every time.
A secrets golden path, with vaulted secrets, none in code, and a populated key-to-owner registry.
Strong, phishing-resistant MFA coverage on privileged accounts.
Documented runbooks and depth across the control plane, so no critical control depends on a single person.


How You Will Work:

You will set standards that partner teams execute. Service Delivery performs provisioning tasks and resets against the verification bar you own. Cloud Engineering carries cloud access, workload identity, and key-management operations, with key access governed by you. HR events are the sole trigger for lifecycle changes. The Governance, Risk & Compliance team independently attests to the entitlements you produce, and access certification deliberately sits outside this role so that the team reviewing access is not the team granting it. Holding those boundaries cleanly is central to the job.

Requirements:

A minimum of 8 years in identity and access management, including principal- or staff-level ownership of an identity control plane.
Deep Microsoft Entra ID engineering, including Conditional Access policy design, phishing-resistant MFA, single sign-on, and federation across SAML, OIDC, and OAuth2, and verifying that enforcement takes effect across every access path, not only the expected one.
Identity lifecycle automation across cloud, SaaS, and privileged systems, with role- and attribute-based provisioning (RBAC/ABAC) and deprovisioning verified against an entitlement inventory.
Zero Trust identity design, including least-privilege, just-in-time (JIT) access, and risk-based or adaptive access controls.
Identity governance and administration (IGA) platform engineering, including privileged access management.
Automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python, or similar) to build lifecycle workflows and custom connectors.
Identity-as-code and policy-as-code practice, using Terraform with source-controlled change management (for example, GitHub).
Secrets and non-human identity (API keys, service accounts, workload identity), and maintaining an owner registry for them.
Key access governance and separation of duties in a model where another team operates the key management system.
The ability to act as the technical authority for a function without formal people-management authority, working directly to a CISO.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience.


Strong Candidates Will:

Healthcare or another regulated environment where identity controls gate access to PHI.
Hands-on Saviynt with PAM, Azure PIM, and Keeper, or transferable depth in comparable platforms.

title: Sr. Zero Trust Engineer III (6794)
desc:
As Sr. Zero Trust Engineer III, you’ll help design and implement identity-centric security for complex cloud and hybrid environments. You will use Microsoft Azure security technologies, automation, and recognized Zero Trust frameworks to reduce risk, strengthen access controls, and improve continuous monitoring across the enterprise.
We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed with our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.
If you think you can see yourself delivering our mission and pursuing our goals with us, then check out the job description below!
What you’ll do:
Zero Trust Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain Zero Trust security architectures that align with NIST SP 800-207, CISA Zero Trust guidance, and applicable organizational cybersecurity requirements across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.
Identity & Access Management (IAM): Implement and manage identity-centric security controls using Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and identity governance solutions.
Cloud Security Engineering: Design and implement security controls for Azure environments using Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, Key Vault, Network Security Groups (NSGs), Azure Firewall, and Private Endpoints to protect critical enterprise workloads.
Microsegmentation & Network Security: Develop and enforce network segmentation strategies using Zero Trust principles to reduce attack surfaces and secure communication between users, devices, applications, and services across enterprise environments.
Security Automation & Compliance: Develop automation using PowerShell, Python, Azure CLI, Terraform, or Bicep to deploy security controls, enforce policy compliance, automate remediation activities, and improve operational efficiency.
Continuous Monitoring & Threat Detection: Configure and optimize Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics to provide continuous monitoring, threat detection, incident response, and security reporting.
Security Assessments & Risk Management: Conduct Zero Trust maturity assessments, architecture reviews, and security gap analyses while developing remediation strategies that improve security posture and support compliance objectives.
DevSecOps Integration: Collaborate with DevSecOps teams to integrate Zero Trust security controls into CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and cloud-native application development processes.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with client stakeholders, cloud architects, cybersecurity teams, system engineers, and program leadership to develop Zero Trust implementation roadmaps, provide technical guidance, and ensure security solutions align with organizational objectives.
What you’ll need to succeed:
Active Top Secret security clearance.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, cloud security engineering, systems engineering, or enterprise security architecture.
5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting Zero Trust architectures within Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud environments.
Strong knowledge of Zero Trust principles and frameworks, including NIST SP 800-207, CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model and other recognized Zero Trust guidance.
Experience implementing Microsoft security technologies, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, Microsoft Intune, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Azure Key Vault.
Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM Templates, or Bicep), cloud automation, and CI/CD platforms such as GitLab, GitHub, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
Proficiency with PowerShell, Python, Azure CLI, or other scripting languages used for security automation and cloud administration.
Strong understanding of Azure networking, identity management, encryption, PKI, network segmentation, secure access, and cloud-native security services.
Experience supporting large enterprise, public sector, or regulated environments and implementing security controls aligned with NIST RMF, FedRAMP, applicable security baselines, and security authorization requirements.
Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to present technical recommendations to engineering teams, cybersecurity leadership, and client stakeholders.

title: Systems Administrator
desc:
Join a team where innovation meets mission. Our AI, cloud, cyber, and modernization solutions save agencies thousands of hours, safeguard national security, and strengthen health and humanitarian missions worldwide. With more than 1,700+ team members, 1,500+ AI & data experts, and 100+ prime contracts, we deliver at scale and with purpose.

We have been recognized as a Top Workplace by The Washington Post for six consecutive years and named to the Inc. 5000 list of Fastest-Growing Private Companies in 13 of the past 14 years. Credence is a welcoming environment for those looking to grow and make a meaningful impact. We encourage employees to push boundaries and help solve critical, world-changing federal challenges.

Position Summary
Credence has an immediate need for a Systems Administrator to support and secure our enterprise IT environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform. This role handles day-to-day systems administration, endpoint management, identity and access administration, and Tier II escalation support for a hybrid workforce operating under federal contractor compliance requirements. Success in this role requires strong Microsoft endpoint and identity administration experience, hands-on vulnerability remediation work, scripting ability in PowerShell or Python, and the judgment to resolve escalated issues independently while documenting what was done.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the duties listed below:

Systems and Endpoint Administration
• Administer and maintain cloud-hosted and endpoint systems across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
• Manage endpoints using Microsoft Endpoint Manager, including Microsoft Intune policy administration and Windows Autopilot deployments.
• Build, maintain, and troubleshoot device compliance policies, configuration profiles, and application deployment packages.
• Maintain software and operating system patch cadence across the managed endpoint fleet.

Identity and Access Administration
• Manage user accounts and directory services including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Group Policy.
• Execute onboarding, offboarding, and access change requests in line with documented Identity and Access Management policy and least-privilege standards.
• Support secure access protocols including conditional access policy administration and multifactor authentication enrollment.

Security Operations Support
• Monitor and triage security alerts in Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel, escalating confirmed incidents to the security and compliance function.
• Execute vulnerability remediation based on Nessus scan results, including system hardening, patching, and verification of closure.
• Administer email security tooling including Proofpoint and secure mail flow policies; analyze email headers in support of phishing investigations.
• Support phishing simulation campaigns and security awareness initiatives run by the security and compliance function.
• Contribute evidence and system configuration detail in support of CMMC and SOC 2 audit readiness cycles.

Support, Automation, and Continuity
• Provide advanced technical support and resolve escalated IT tickets with professionalism and efficiency.
• Strong scripting and writing capability in PowerShell and Python for scripting to automate and integration repetitive administrative tasks and reporting.
• Assist in disaster recovery planning, backup strategy, and restoration testing.
• Write and maintain technical documentation and internal knowledge base articles for procedures owned by this role.
• Participate in a bi-weekly on-call rotation to provide after-hours support as needed.


Requirements

Required Qualifications
• • U.S. Citizenship with the ability to obtain a Top Secret or TS/SCI. 
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• 5+ years of experience in systems administration with a security-conscious operating approach.
• Proficient in administering Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform environments.
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot in a managed endpoint environment.
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Proofpoint, and Nessus or an equivalent vulnerability management platform.
• Strong scripting skills in PowerShell and/or Python for automation and integration tasks.
• Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems, including server administration fundamentals.
• Familiarity with backup systems, disaster recovery protocols, and enterprise networking fundamentals.
• Excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive data.

Preferred Qualifications
• Certifications such as Microsoft AZ-500, AWS Certified Security Specialty, AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, CompTIA Security+, CCNA, CISSP, AWS Security Specialty or similar.
• Background administering virtualized server environments such as VMware or Hyper-V, as evidence of transferable Windows and Linux server administration depth applicable to cloud-hosted compute.
• Experience supporting a federal contractor environment, including familiarity with CMMC Level 2 and SOC 2 requirements.
• Working understanding of compliance frameworks such as NIST 800-171, ISO 27001/27002, and CMMC.
• Familiarity with JSON and YAML, and with infrastructure-as-code or configuration management tooling.
• Experience contributing to IT or security project initiatives beyond day-to-day operational support.
• This position is supporting a Federal Contractor environment familiarity working with teams that support cleared environment is preferred 

Salary Range: $110,000.00 to $140,000.00 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on the selected candidate's experience, education, skills, and overall qualifications

title: Senior Software Engineer
desc:
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with strong hands-on experience building, operating, and maintaining large-scale production systems. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Python, Azure cloud services, distributed systems, and production AI applications.
This role requires engineers with genuine production ownership, on-call experience, and the ability to troubleshoot complex live incidents. Candidates should have experience building reliable, scalable backend services and maintaining AI-powered systems in real-world production environments. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on production stability, technical ownership, and engineering excellence rather than research or proof-of-concept development.


Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain production-grade Python services, ensuring scalability, reliability, performance, and operational stability.
Build and operate Azure-native distributed systems using Azure Functions, Durable Functions, Event Grid, Service Bus, and supporting cloud infrastructure.
Develop and maintain production-ready AI solutions, including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and LLM orchestration frameworks.
Work with AI frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, and Semantic Kernel.
Diagnose and resolve production incidents using distributed tracing, log analytics, profilers, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights.
Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks, cold-start latency, distributed failures, event-ordering issues, and scaling challenges.
Establish engineering best practices around code reviews, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment safety, and rollback strategies.
Own production incident investigation, root cause analysis (RCA), remediation, and post-mortem activities.
Contribute to secondary technology stacks, including C#, when required.
Drive continuous improvements in system reliability, observability, operational automation, and engineering quality.
Required Qualifications
Minimum 8–10+ years of professional backend or distributed systems engineering experience.
Strong hands-on expertise in Python, including performance optimization, concurrency, debugging, and production reliability.
Proven experience building, deploying, and supporting Azure-based production systems.
Hands-on experience with Azure Functions, Durable Functions, Event Grid, and Service Bus.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, scalability, fault tolerance, and operational recovery.
Experience owning and resolving live production incidents, including root cause identification, remediation, validation, and preventive measures.
Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across complex production environments.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment strategies, and rollback mechanisms.
Ability to demonstrate end-to-end ownership of production applications and services.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building, deploying, and maintaining production Generative AI, LLM, and RAG applications.
Hands-on experience with agentic AI workflows and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, and Semantic Kernel.
Experience with high-concurrency distributed systems, queue-backed architectures, streaming platforms, and large-scale SQL/NoSQL workloads.
Experience managing production AI challenges, including prompt drift, latency optimization, evaluation degradation, and cost management.
Working knowledge of C# and experience contributing to polyglot technology environments.
Strong understanding of DevOps practices, observability, incident management, and production deployment automation.
Important Requirements
Candidates must have genuine hands-on production engineering experience, not just POCs, prototypes, or research exposure.
Practical on-call experience and ownership of live production incidents are essential.
Candidates must be comfortable attending initial in-person interviews.
Hybrid work arrangement requires 3 days per week in the Manhattan, NYC office. Seattle-based candidates are also being considered; office arrangements should be confirmed.
Comprehensive background and professional experience verification will be conducted.

BrickRed Systems is a global leader in next-generation technology consulting and workforce solutions, specializing in delivering high-quality talent across digital, engineering, marketing, analytics, finance, operations, and business transformation domains. With a strong emphasis on innovation, scalability, and client success, BrickRed Systems helps organizations solve complex business challenges by providing skilled professionals across strategy, technology, creative, and operational functions. BrickRed fosters a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and excellence, enabling professionals to contribute to high-impact global initiatives while advancing their careers.

title: Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer
desc:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer based in United States .

The Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer will design, implement, automate, and support secure, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure within an enterprise Azure environment. Working under the direction of a Principal Azure Architect, you will lead complex technical workstreams and contribute to cloud architecture, modernization, and operational excellence. The role spans Azure networking, virtual desktop infrastructure, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps automation, data services, and emerging AI and machine learning capabilities. You will collaborate with architecture, security, application, infrastructure, and data teams to deliver reliable solutions that meet business and technical requirements. This hands-on position also involves troubleshooting critical production issues, strengthening governance and business continuity, and improving cloud performance and cost efficiency. You will contribute to engineering standards while mentoring colleagues and promoting consistent practices across the team.

Accountabilities

Design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable, highly available, and supportable Azure solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards. 
Partner with the Principal Azure Architect on solution design, technical standards, architecture reviews, and cloud modernization initiatives. 
Lead assigned Azure projects and complex technical workstreams from initial design through implementation and operational handoff. 
Implement and support Azure networking components, including virtual networks, route tables, DNS zones, VPN, ExpressRoute, private endpoints, network virtual appliance firewalls, network security groups, and hybrid connectivity. 
Deploy, maintain, and optimize Azure Virtual Desktop environments. 
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Azure Bicep, Azure DevOps pipelines, and other appropriate automation tools. 
Write, review, and troubleshoot advanced PowerShell and Azure CLI scripts to automate infrastructure operations. 
Implement and support Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Kubernetes environments, covering networking, identity, ingress, secrets management, monitoring, upgrades, and workload deployment. 
Apply Azure security and governance controls, including Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access control (RBAC), managed identities, Key Vault, Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, logging, and monitoring. 
Implement and support business continuity, disaster recovery, backup, and recovery testing activities in line with established recovery objectives. 
Deploy and optimize Azure data services, including Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, and related integration services. 
Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to build secure, supportable RStudio and advanced analytics environments in Azure. 
Support Azure AI and machine learning initiatives, including Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI services, Azure Machine Learning, model deployment, and data science workflows. 
Build and maintain Azure DevOps repositories, CI/CD pipelines, release processes, deployment strategies, and environment automation. 
Contribute to cloud migration and modernization projects, including application assessments, containerization, and workload migration. 
Monitor and improve infrastructure performance, availability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency. 
Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, implementation plans, operational procedures, and support runbooks. 
Troubleshoot complex technical issues, participate in incident response and root-cause analysis, and drive corrective actions through to resolution. 
Mentor other engineers, encourage consistent Azure engineering practices, and stay current with emerging Azure capabilities to recommend improvements. 


Requirements

At least 7 years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, cloud engineering, platform engineering, or solution delivery. 
At least 5 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting Microsoft Azure environments. 
Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills, with practical experience using Azure CLI. 
Broad technical knowledge of the Azure ecosystem, including networking, Azure Virtual Desktop, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, data services, and cloud security. 
Experience designing or implementing business continuity and disaster recovery solutions. 
Ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical problems, make sound implementation decisions, and drive issues to resolution. 
Experience working within established architecture, security, governance, and operational standards. 
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. 
A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered. 
Authorization to work in Canada or the United States without current or future sponsorship. 
Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate and/or Azure Network Engineer Associate certifications are preferred. 
Experience with Bicep, Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics is an advantage. 
Familiarity with regulated, highly controlled, or GxP environments is preferred. 
Experience in cloud migration, platform modernization, or enterprise infrastructure transformation is beneficial. 
Knowledge of Microsoft Purview, Azure Databricks, MLOps, or responsible AI practices is an asset. 
Experience supporting RStudio, data science, analytics, Azure AI, or machine learning environments is desirable. 
Strong Azure DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipelines, Git, release management, and deployment automation, is preferred.

Full-time employment. 
Remote work opportunity available in Canada and the United States.

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to manage multiple priorities
2+ years of experience with network configurations, VPNs, firewalls, and hybrid cloud connectivity

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

You take ownership of cloud administration responsibilities and follow through on maintenance, backups, configuration, and support work
