title: Salesforce - Head of Delivery & Architecture
desc:
About Truffle
Truffle is an AI-native consulting firm built around Salesforce. Founded by a Salesforce Certified Technical Architect, we deliver complex programs across Agentforce, Data Cloud, Service Cloud Voice, MuleSoft, and enterprise integrations.


We are a small, senior team where the people closest to the work have the authority and responsibility to own outcomes.


The Opportunity
We are looking for a senior Salesforce architecture and delivery leader to own the technical direction, client relationships, delivery outcomes, team performance, and economics across complex AI and Salesforce engagements.


This is a hands-on leadership role, not a portfolio-governance position several layers removed from the work. You will make and defend architecture decisions, lead executive steering committees, shape estimates and SOWs, manage delivery economics, handle escalations, and stay close enough to the technology to challenge designs and unblock teams.


What You’ll Own
Lead complex Salesforce and AI programs from kickoff through production and account expansion
Own solution architecture, data models, integration boundaries, security, governance, and Salesforce platform decisions
Review designs and implementations, challenge technical assumptions, and sign off on major architecture decisions
Lead executive readouts, steering committees, escalations, and critical client conversations
Manage scope, estimates, staffing, utilization, burn, margin, forecasting, and change control
Lead distributed teams across the United States and India
Develop architects, project managers, engineers, and consultants
Identify account-expansion opportunities and help shape the architecture, scope, and estimates for new work
Improve Truffle’s delivery methods, including estimation, quality, incidents, releases, executive communication, and AI-assisted delivery


What You Bring
10+ years delivering enterprise technology programs in consulting or professional services
5+ years as an accountable architect, technical lead, or equivalent leader on Salesforce implementations
A record of personally owning both architecture decisions and delivery outcomes
Strong depth in at least two of the following: Agentforce, Data Cloud, Service Cloud Voice or Amazon Connect, MuleSoft, Enterprise Integration platforms
Experience designing complex enterprise architectures and defending technical tradeoffs with client architects
Experience building estimates, work breakdowns, SOWs, and change orders
Experience leading distributed onshore and offshore teams
Strong understanding of consulting economics, including scope, staffing, utilization, burn, margin, and forecasting
Executive presence with C-level, technology, and finance stakeholders
Experience managing production incidents, difficult client conversations, and engagements that have gone off track
The ability to operate independently in a fast-moving, high-accountability environment
Active, practical use of AI in your own research, analysis, documentation, operating workflows, and problem-solving


Preferred Qualifications
Salesforce Certified Technical Architect or active CTA path
Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Integration Architect, or Data Cloud credentials
Contact-center or voice architecture experience
Experience delivering AI agents into production
Experience in a boutique or high-growth consulting firm


How You’ll Work
Truffle operates differently from a large consulting organization. There are fewer layers, significant individual ownership, and an expectation that decisions move quickly. You should be comfortable moving directly between executive conversations, delivery issues, and technical architecture while bringing recommendations, making tradeoffs clear, and moving decisions forward.
AI fluency is part of how we operate, not just part of what we deliver. We are looking for someone who already uses AI actively to research, analyze, document, operate, and solve problems. You should be able to show how AI has changed your own workflows and increased your effectiveness, not simply demonstrate familiarity with AI technologies.


Compensation and Benefits
The base salary range is $190,000–$210,000, based on architecture depth and the scale of programs previously owned. The role is eligible for an annual performance bonus of up to 25% of base salary.


Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), flexible paid time off, home-office support, and paid Salesforce certification and CTA preparation.


This job is part of LinkedIn’s Full-Service Hiring beta program. Eligibility is limited to candidates located in and performing services in the United States, excluding those based in Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, South Carolina, or West Virginia.


We’re committed to making our hiring process as smooth and timely as possible, and we understand that waiting to hear back can add to the anticipation. If you’re a potential fit, our team will reach out within two weeks to progress you to the next stage. If you don’t hear from us in that time, we encourage you to explore other opportunities with our team in the future, and we wish you the very best in your job search.

title: Director, Business Systems & AI Enablement (Remote EST – United States)
desc:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Most companies are still talking about AI. We want someone who will put it to work.

As Director, Business Systems & AI Enablement, you'll lead how Partnerize uses technology to run a smarter, faster business. You'll own Salesforce and Asana, the core platforms our teams use every day, along with the integrations that connect them to other business systems such as NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign. You'll also bring enterprise AI tools like Google Gemini Enterprise into how we work, so our teams spend less time on manual work and more time on customers and growth.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary for this position ranges from $145,000 to $170,000 USD annually, plus a 10% annual performance-based bonus.

You'll be a player-coach. You'll lead and develop a small team of two while rolling up your sleeves yourself. One week you might be redesigning a Salesforce sales workflow. The next, you might be building a Gemini agent that removes hours of admin from the Sales team, or presenting ROI results to the executive team.

What you'll own:



Business systems: the roadmap, intake, delivery and vendor relationships for Salesforce, Asana and the integrations that connect them across the business.
Process optimization: finding friction, redesigning workflows and making sure data stays clean as we scale.
AI enablement: rolling out enterprise AI, designing functional agents, driving adoption and measuring the results.


You won't be doing this alone. You'll be part of a leadership group shaping how Partnerize moves into a human-AI enabled future, with one shared goal: a workplace where people and AI do their best work together. Our Director, Product brings the vision for AI in the Partnerize platform. Our Director, Business Performance Optimization brings the framework we use to evaluate new AI opportunities and helps guide proofs of concept. Our People Success team makes sure our people grow alongside the technology. You bring it all to life across the business: working with teams to find where AI can make the biggest difference, then turning big ideas into real change in how we work every day.This role has high visibility and real autonomy. You'll have a direct line to measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

 Business Systems & Process Optimization
Salesforce & Asana ownership: Own the configuration, roadmap and health of Salesforce and Asana as our primary business platforms, ensuring they scale with the business and support clean, reliable data.
Integration oversight: Oversee the integrations between Salesforce and Asana and connected systems, including NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign, so data flows accurately across Sales, Marketing, Finance and Operations.
Process optimization: Find friction in how teams work and redesign processes to improve efficiency, data quality and scalability.
Requirements and solution design: Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance and Operations to develop user stories, define solution designs and write clear business requirements.
Agile delivery: Manage intake and triage for business systems requests. Prioritize and maintain backlogs in Jira so developers can deliver smoothly.
Hands-on building: Personally configure, prototype and build solutions (e.g., Salesforce Flows, Asana workflows, Gemini agents) alongside your team.
Testing and quality: Own the strategy and execution of user acceptance testing (UAT) so delivered solutions meet business requirements.
Change management and enablement: Lead end-user training, documentation, process flows, data dictionaries and communications for new features and workflow changes.
 AI Enablement & Agent Adoption


This role leads internal AI adoption in close partnership with Product, Business Performance Optimization and People Success.

Enterprise AI platform ownership: Act as the internal product owner for enterprise AI platforms, starting with Google Gemini Enterprise. Manage rollouts, end-user enablement, prompt templates and feature adoption.
Agent and workflow design: Lead the design, testing and deployment of functional, business-led agents and automated multi-step workflows that remove manual work across teams.
AI embedded in core systems: Identify opportunities to embed AI and automation directly into Salesforce and Asana workflows, not just alongside them.
AI opportunity delivery: Work with business teams to find high-impact AI use cases. Take them through the Business Performance Optimization evaluation framework, partner on proofs of concept, and lead approved tools from pilot to full rollout.
AI governance: Put responsible-use guidelines, data security practices and access controls into practice for internal AI tools, in partnership with IT, Security and Legal.
Impact measurement: Define, track and report on business outcomes such as hours saved, cycle-time reduction and adoption rates, with seat utilization as one input, to show the ROI of AI across departments.
 Leadership & Strategy
Team leadership: Lead, coach and develop a team of two business systems professionals, and manage external consultants as needed. Set clear goals, run performance reviews and support ongoing growth.
Roadmap and prioritization: Own the consolidated Business Systems and AI roadmap across departments. Balance competing requests against company priorities, and explain "No" or "Not Yet" decisions clearly.
Vendor and license management: Manage relationships, SLAs and engagements with software vendors and implementation partners. Oversee renewals and license optimization to control cost.
Key partnerships: Work closely with the Director, Product, sharing AI learnings, tools and vendor insights so internal and product AI efforts stay aligned. Partner with the Director, Business Performance Optimization to take AI opportunities through the evaluation framework and proofs of concept to delivered, measurable business results. Work with People Success on AI skills, change readiness and how roles evolve as AI takes on more routine work.
Internal champion: Advocate for technology and AI modernization across the company, and communicate the value the Business Systems team delivers to executives and department heads.


What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: Assess the current Salesforce, Asana and integration landscape. Build relationships with key stakeholders. Deliver an initial prioritized Business Systems and AI roadmap.
First 6 months: Launch at least [X] functional AI agents or automated workflows in production. Establish an AI adoption and impact dashboard. Streamline intake and delivery processes.
First 12 months: Reach 100% active adoption of Gemini Enterprise. Show measurable time savings of [X] hours per month across teams. Present a roadmap approved by the executive team for the following year.


What You Bring

Experience

7+ years of progressive experience in business systems, business process optimization or enterprise application management.
Experience leading, coaching or managing business analysts, systems administrators or similar roles. You enjoy building as much as leading.
Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


Technical Skills

Salesforce: Deep hands-on administrator or power-user experience, including automation (e.g., Flows) and data management.
Asana or similar work management platforms: Experience configuring and scaling tools such as Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet or similar.
Integrations: Working knowledge of how core platforms connect to systems like NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign. A solid understanding of APIs, data models, ETL and data sync between systems.
AI and automation: Practical experience rolling out and driving adoption of commercial AI tools (e.g., Google Gemini Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot), including prompt design, agent or workflow building and measuring impact. Experience with automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Workato) is a plus.
Agile delivery: Experience managing backlogs, prioritizing sprints and writing user stories in Jira.


Leadership & Communication

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical workflows in clear business language.
A collaborative style, with experience delivering results through peer partnerships where ownership is shared across functions.
Proven ability to manage executive expectations, work through competing requests and apply prioritization frameworks with tact.
Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and technologies.


Nice-to-Haves

Salesforce certification(s) (e.g., Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst).
Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities 
Familiarity with digital, performance, affiliate or partner marketing.
Experience supporting users across multiple regions (EMEA, Americas, APAC).
Training or certification in process improvement methods (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma).


US Benefits & Perks

Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
Enhanced Parental Leave: 16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
401k Plan – 4% employee match
Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP and Wellness Coaching 
Regular company events and activities


Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization’s success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

title: Sr. IT Systems Engineer
desc:
About Carrot: 
Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.
 The Opportunity 🚀
Carrot is looking for a Sr. IT Systems Engineer to design, scale, and secure the identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms that power our global, remote-first workforce. You will set the technical direction for how employees and devices connect to Carrot systems, while staying hands-on in the tooling, automation, and complex problem-solving that make IT reliable at scale.
This role sits at the center of IT engineering. You will lead larger initiatives from design through rollout, partner closely with Information Security on zero-trust and compliance priorities, and raise the bar for the rest of the team through standards, documentation, and mentorship. If you want broad technical ownership, influence over the IT roadmap, and the chance to build systems that grow with a high-growth healthcare company, this role was built for that.
What You’ll Own 💼
In this role, you will:
Architect and own Carrot's identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms, including Okta, JAMF, Intune, and Google Workspace, with a focus on security, reliability, and user experience
Lead design and rollout of larger IT initiatives, such as zero-trust access models, device compliance frameworks, and global endpoint standards
Build and maintain automation and infrastructure as code that manage configuration, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows at scale
Partner with Information Security to design controls, drive vulnerability management, and keep Carrot audit-ready for SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security reviews
Serve as the senior technical escalation point, leading incident response and root cause analysis for complex or high-impact issues
Define engineering standards, runbooks, and documentation, and mentor IT teammates to grow their technical depth
Evaluate vendors and tools, build business cases, and make clear recommendations on build versus buy tradeoffs
Design environments that support global care and operations teams, including secure and efficient remote computing setups
Contribute to the IT roadmap and communicate priorities, risks, and progress to technical and business stakeholders
What Success Looks Like  📈
In your first 12–18 months, you will have:
Established a clear, documented architecture and standards for identity, endpoint, and SaaS management that the team can build on
Delivered at least one major platform initiative, such as a zero-trust access model or endpoint modernization, with measurable gains in security posture and employee experience
Reduced manual IT work through automation and infrastructure as code, with a measurable drop in recurring ticket volume
Strengthened audit readiness, contributing to clean results on security and compliance reviews
Raised the technical capability of the team through mentorship, documentation, and shared standards
Built trusted partnerships with Information Security, People, Engineering, and Finance
About You ✨
You likely have:
6+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint engineering, or infrastructure roles, including ownership of production platforms
Deep, hands-on expertise with identity and access platforms such as Okta, including SSO, SCIM, lifecycle automation, and conditional access
Expert-level experience managing Mac and Windows fleets with JAMF and Intune, including packaging, deployment, security policy, and compliance enforcement
Strong scripting and automation skills (for example Python, Bash, or PowerShell), with experience using APIs and source-controlled configuration
Experience designing and implementing security controls, such as encryption, vulnerability management, and zero-trust principles, in partnership with Security teams

desc:

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era.  The TDI Client Platform Engineering TeamThe Technology, Data, and Insights (TDI) team is on a mission to accelerate Okta’s scale. The Staff Client Platform Engineer OpportunityAs a Staff Client Platform Engineer, you will be the subject matter expert for Okta’s macOS and iOS fleet. This is an ideal path for an engineer who wants to maintain deep Apple expertise while expanding their influence across the entire OS landscape.
We are looking for a versatile engineer who thinks automation-first. You will combine Jamf Pro expertise with open-source tools like Munki and Santa, while helping to bridge the gap between platforms using unified tools like FleetDM.
What makes this role unique: You are Customer Zero. Because we build identity and device management products, you will work directly with Okta’s own Product and Engineering teams to validate new capabilities across platforms, surface real-world feedback, and help shape the roadmap for tools used by millions of people globally.
This role reports to the Senior Manager of Client Platform Engineering.

Cross-Platform Support: Contribute to the management and security of Windows (via Intune/Autopilot) and Linux endpoints as the program evolves, ensuring a consistent security posture across all OS types.

Security & Compliance: Ensure endpoints meet NIST, CIS, and STIG standards. Partner with Security teams to respond to vulnerabilities across the entire fleet.
Engineering & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Apply an IaC mindset to device management using code-based workflows (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, or Jamf API). Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure repeatable, scalable, and automated deployments regardless of the OS.
Technical Direction: Set the architecture and technical direction for a domain, such as Apple platform, endpoint security tooling or devices-as-code, and write design or docs that formalize it.
Customer Zero Advocacy: Act as a primary feedback loop for Okta’s internal product teams. Test new features in production and influence the product roadmap based on operational data.
Operational Excellence: Provide Tier 3 escalation support for global IT teams and participate in an on-call rotation.
What You’ll BringCore Experience: 8+ years in endpoint engineering with a focus on Apple platforms at enterprise scale.
Technical Versatility: A strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems; you aren't just a "Mac person", you understand how to apply engineering principles to any OS.
MDM Mastery: Deep expertise in managing endpoints at scale via MDM, such as Jamf Pro. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, FleetDM or other cross-platform MDM/UEM solutions is a significant plus.
Scripting: Proficiency in Bash, Python, Go, or Swift (PowerShell experience is a bonus).
Tooling: Experience with Git, GitHub Actions, Terraform, or similar CI/CD frameworks.
Security: Understanding of ADE/DEP, MDM/DDM protocols, and platform-specific hardening (e.g., BitLocker, FileVault, LUKS).
Identity Knowledge: Familiarity with SAML and OIDC and how they integrate with endpoint authentication.

title: Senior Director, IT
desc:
About Arena Club 

Arena Club is building the number one digital marketplace for collectibles. We started by reinventing the hobby with the first-ever digital card show, and we are expanding into new categories so collectors can buy, sell, grade, and showcase everything they care about in one place. Spearheaded by 5x World Series Champion Derek Jeter and serial entrepreneur Brian Lee, our fully digital marketplace is grounded in trust, transparency, and fun, featuring grading and authentication, vaulting, and digital pack openings that let collectors build and display their collections in a personalized online showroom from anywhere in the world.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Director of Information Technology. As our first dedicated IT hire, you’ll be responsible for building and scaling a global function. You’ll also own business applications, identity, devices, SaaS, and IT controls.

What You’ll Do

Own the IT strategy, roadmap, and budget: establish IT as a function with clear service levels that enable a fast-growing business. 
Own identity and access end to end: SSO and SAML, SCIM provisioning, group and role design, MFA, privileged access, and a joiner-mover-leaver process that actually runs on time
Own device management across macOS and Windows: MDM baselines, encryption, patching, remote wipe, procurement, and the offboarding returns that most companies quietly fail at
Own the SaaS estate: application inventory, admin and role hygiene, seat reconciliation against budget owners, renewal calendar, and vendor consolidation. Know what we pay for and who uses it
Drive readiness and evidence for compliance work: own the access reviews, offboarding logs, and control documentation auditors and partners ask for
Own business continuity and disaster recovery for corporate systems: including backup, testing, and a documented plan for the day the office or the vault network goes down
Own IT vendor and MSP: relationships, contracts, and spend, and decide deliberately what to build in-house versus outsource
Own onboarding and offboarding as an experience: day-one readiness for every new hire and same-day access removal for every departure


Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
10+ years in IT, including 4+ years leading an IT function or team
Hands-on identity administration; SSO/SAML, SCIM, OAuth, group and role models
Hands-on device management: MDM for macOS and Windows at scale (Kandji, Jamf, or equivalent)
Expert-level administration of a modern SaaS stack (Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, Okta, Slack, and the surrounding tools)
Scripting and automation ability (Bash, PowerShell, Python) and comfort with APIs and integrations
Demonstrated experience building an IT function from a low baseline, including standing up helpdesk, policy, and asset management from scratch
Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS) and experience producing evidence for an audit
Genuine service orientation. You measure yourself on whether the company can work, and you can explain a technical constraint to a non-technical executive without condescension
Willingness to be onsite regularly, including at our operations facility
Comfort with using AI tooling to eliminate repetitive IT work and to improve support response


The base salary range listed is a guideline. Actual compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the impact you bring. Total compensation includes base salary, bonus, and equity.

Salary Range: $220,000 USD - $280,000 USD

title: Senior Enterprise New Logo Account Executive | Federal Government
desc:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. The Senior Enterprise New Logo Account Executive (Government) is a strategic enterprise hunter responsible for driving net-new logo acquisition across federal, state, and local government agencies.

This is a pure new logo role, focused on identifying, targeting, and closing net-new public sector accounts. You’ll navigate complex government buying environments, align to mission-driven outcomes, and secure high-value contracts that establish long-term, compliant partnerships.

For those candidates who live near a Jamf office, you may be expected to work periodically in-office or collaborative work location with other Jamf employees in your area for certain events or moments that matter. For those candidates who are not near a Jamf office, this role may be offered as remote. 

What you can expect to do in this role:

Government New Logo Acquisition

Build and execute a territory strategy focused on landing net-new government agencies (Federal, SLG, or Tribal) within an assigned segment.
Develop deep public sector expertise — including procurement vehicles, budget cycles, compliance frameworks (e.g., FedRAMP, CJIS, StateRAMP), and agency mission priorities.
Generate pipeline through strategic outbound, public sector events, partner collaboration, and targeted ABM campaigns aligned to government personas.
Engage multi-layered stakeholder groups including IT, Security, Procurement Officers, Contracting Officers, Program Owners, and executive leadership.
Align Jamf’s value to mission outcomes such as cybersecurity posture, digital transformation, workforce mobility, and compliance mandates.


Public Sector Deal Execution & Procurement Navigation

Build trusted advisor relationships with agency leaders, aligning Jamf solutions to mission-critical initiatives and regulatory requirements.
Deliver executive-level presentations and business cases tied to public sector priorities: security, compliance, cost efficiency, and operational effectiveness.
Partner closely with Apple’s public sector teams, system integrators (SIs), resellers, and contract holders to drive joint pipeline and win strategies.
Leverage partner ecosystems to access contract vehicles and accelerate time-to-award.


Executive Engagement & Partner Ecosystem

Build multi-threaded C-suite relationships early, before formal buying processes start — never rely on a single thread.
Position yourself as a trusted advisor on Apple enterprise management and endpoint security, bringing a segment-informed point of view.
Deliver executive presentations and ROI business cases tied to board-level priorities: security posture, workforce productivity, compliance, and TCO.
Own strategic relationships with Apple's enterprise team and key channel/SI partners, with joint business planning that creates a durable pipeline.


Forecasting, Pipeline & Market Intelligence

Maintain a strong, qualified pipeline with accurate forecasting and disciplined deal progression in Salesforce.
Develop and share public sector intelligence: budget trends, policy changes, competitive positioning, and procurement insights.
Contribute to government GTM strategy, including ICP refinement, messaging, and vertical playbooks.
Mentor peers on public sector selling strategies, procurement navigation, and enterprise deal execution.


What we are looking for:

8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of quota attainment. (Required)
Proven success selling into government/public sector accounts (Federal or SLG), including net-new logo acquisition. (Required)
Deep understanding of public sector procurement processes, contract vehicles, and budgeting cycles. (Required)
Experience navigating compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, CJIS, StateRAMP, or equivalent. (Preferred)
Expertise in managing complex, multi-stakeholder government sales cycles, including contracting and procurement officers.
Proficiency in MEDDPICC (or similar) applied to long, complex public sector deals.
Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to align solutions to mission-driven outcomes.
Experience working with channel partners, resellers, and system integrators in the public sector ecosystem.
Familiarity with endpoint management, Apple ecosystem, or security technologies (preferred).
Executive presence with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical government stakeholders.
Highly self-motivated and effective in navigating long, ambiguous, and highly regulated sales cycless


How we help you reach your best potential:

Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.


Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

For sales and commission-based roles, we post On-Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus estimated commission based on achieving 100% of performance targets. Commission is not guaranteed and varies based on individual performance results.

The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

National Pay Transparency Range

$144,400—$331,040 USD

What it means to be a Jamf?

We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Enterprise Applications Engineer – Microsoft 365


The BayTech Group is seeking an experienced Enterprise Applications Engineer to support and enhance a sophisticated Microsoft 365 and enterprise applications environment.
This role will focus heavily on the administration, engineering, integration, and optimization of the Microsoft 365 platform, while also supporting a broader portfolio of enterprise applications.


Key Responsibilities
Engineer, administer, and support Microsoft 365 applications and services
Support Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Entra ID, and related M365 technologies
Troubleshoot complex application, integration, authentication, and performance issues
Develop PowerShell scripts and automation to improve administration and operational efficiency
Participate in application upgrades, migrations, deployments, and integrations
Work with security and infrastructure teams on identity, access, compliance, and application security
Evaluate new Microsoft 365 capabilities and help drive adoption across the organization
Support and integrate additional enterprise applications as needed


Ideal Background
Strong hands-on experience engineering and supporting Microsoft 365 / Office 365
Experience with Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Entra ID
Strong PowerShell skills helpful
Experience with enterprise application integrations and troubleshooting
Familiarity with Intune, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, Purview, Defender, or Microsoft 365 Copilot is a plus
Experience supporting a large professional-services, legal, financial-services, or similarly complex enterprise environment is preferred


This is an opportunity to join a highly collaborative technology organization and work across both established enterprise platforms and emerging Microsoft technologies.

title: Microsoft Engineer
desc:
M365 Collaboration & AI Automation Engineer
Our client's Messaging and Collaboration team is hiring engineers who can automate, extend and modernize the Microsoft 365 environment using low-code tools, scripting and AI. You will build Power Platform solutions, roll out and support Microsoft Copilot, and use Python, PowerShell and GitHub to replace manual work with reliable, repeatable processes. This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable with Claude and other AI tools as with a PowerShell console.
Responsibilities
Design, build and support low-code solutions in Power Apps, Power Automate and Power Pages for internal and external users
Support and enhance the Microsoft 365 messaging and collaboration environment, including Exchange Online, Teams and SharePoint
Deploy, configure and drive adoption of Microsoft Copilot across the organization
Evaluate and integrate AI tools, including Claude and other large language models, into everyday business workflows
Write Python and PowerShell scripts to automate administration, provisioning, reporting and migration tasks
Manage code, scripts and workflow definitions in GitHub using version control and review practices
Partner with business and IT stakeholders to turn requirements into working, documented solutions
Troubleshoot issues, maintain documentation and follow security, governance and change-management standards
Required Skills
Python: scripting and automation, including API integrations
PowerShell: administering Microsoft 365 and Azure environments
Microsoft Copilot: Microsoft 365 Copilot and/or Copilot Studio
AI and LLM tools: practical use of generative AI, including Claude, for automation, prompt design and workflow integration
Power Pages and the Power Platform: building and maintaining portals and apps with Power Apps and Power Automate
Low-code development: delivering business solutions with minimal custom code
GitHub: repositories, branching, pull requests and, ideally, GitHub Actions
Preferred Qualifications
3+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 administration, engineering or development
Microsoft certifications such as PL-200, PL-400, MS-102 or AI-900
Experience with Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and Entra ID
Background in healthcare, higher education or another regulated environment
Familiarity with data governance, security and compliance requirements for AI tools
Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to document and train others

title: Systems Engineer - Mergers & Acquisitions Integration
desc:
BKF is a multi-service infrastructure consulting firm providing civil engineering, construction management, environmental, planning, and surveying services across California, the Pacific Northwest, and beyond. With offices throughout California and the Portland area, BKF has served transportation, water resources, land development, government, and federal clients for over 110 years.

At BKF, you'll find a unique opportunity to grow your career with intention. Our culture values professional autonomy, innovation, and meaningful collaboration across offices. We are proud to be recognized with the Great Place to Work certification for the second year in a row.

The Systems Engineer - M&A Integration executes technical integration activities associated with mergers and acquisitions. The role supports the onboarding of acquired companies into BKF's technology environment, with a primary focus on Microsoft 365, identity, collaboration services, security controls, and related cloud technologies.

Reporting to the M&A Integration Lead and receiving technical direction from the Senior M&A Technology Integration Engineer, this position performs hands-on migration, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, cutover, and hypercare activities across multiple acquisitions each year.

The ideal candidate is a technical generalist with strong Microsoft cloud and identity experience who can work independently while following established integration architecture, standards, and migration plans.

Responsibilities

Execute technical integration activities for acquired companies in accordance with approved architecture, migration plans, and BKF standards. 
Perform migrations into BKF's standard platforms, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive-to-Box migrations. 
Support migrations from Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 tenants, and other source environments. 
Execute identity and access integration activities involving Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, SSO, MFA, conditional access, provisioning, and account lifecycle management. 
Support the technical dependencies associated with endpoint deployment, including identity, Intune enrollment, application access, security policies, and user authentication. 
Support Azure and related cloud-integration activities when required, including access, permissions, subscriptions, and coordination with Cloud Operations. 
Partner with acquired-company IT teams, internal stakeholders, consultants, and vendors to gather technical information and complete integration work. 
Follow migration runbooks, cutover plans, validation procedures, rollback plans, and hypercare processes. 
Troubleshoot technical issues during migration, cutover, and stabilization. 
Support the integration of security, compliance, endpoint-protection, and IT-management platforms. 
Document source environments, migration activities, configurations, dependencies, risks, and completion status. 
Build and improve reusable integration playbooks, standards, checklists, scripts, and automation. 
Escalate technical risks, blockers, and design decisions to the Senior M&A Technology Integration Engineer. 



Requirements

Hands-on experience administering and migrating Microsoft 365 environments, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive. 
Experience supporting tenant, email, collaboration-platform, or other enterprise IT migrations. 
Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, identity synchronization, MFA, SSO, and conditional access. 
Experience with Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Configuration Manager, or a comparable endpoint-management platform. 
Experience supporting endpoint readiness, device enrollment, application deployment, and user onboarding. 
Familiarity with Azure administration, access, permissions, subscriptions, networking concepts, and cloud services. 
Ability to troubleshoot across identity, email, collaboration, endpoint, and cloud environments. 
Strong PowerShell, documentation, and technical-procedure skills. 
Ability to support multiple concurrent acquisition projects and planned after-hours or weekend cutovers. 
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with internal teams, consultants, vendors, and acquired-company personnel. 
Ability to work independently while escalating risks and technical decisions appropriately. 
Experience with Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations. 
Experience migrating Google Workspace environments to Microsoft platforms. 
Experience with migration tools such as BitTitan MigrationWiz, Quest, AvePoint, ShareGate, or comparable solutions. 
Experience automating Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Intune, or Azure activities with PowerShell. 
Familiarity with Microsoft Defender, Purview, Sentinel, or related security platforms. 
Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, or enterprise onboarding. 
Experience working with managed service providers, consultants, or integration vendors. 
Familiarity with ITSM, change-management, and technical project-tracking processes. 
Relevant Microsoft certifications. 


Physical Demands: Must be able to regularly talk, hear and operate a computer, keyboard and mouse and occasionally lift, pull/push and carry up to 20 pounds with accommodations.

Work Conditions: Exposure to constant or intermittent sounds at a low or moderate level consistent with an office setting. Exposure to high-stress, fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment. Travel to other BKF locations and client sites may be required.

Benefits

The typical base salary range for this position is $100,000.00- $135,000.00, annualized depending upon skills, experience, education, and geographical location. This is a salary position paid biweekly
Competitive salaries, profit sharing, and 401k
Generous paid time off packages
9 Paid Holidays
Flexible schedules
Education reimbursement, paid annual dues for professional and societal organizations
